verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for a cloud storage service. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking opt-out for Google Drive. The pack covers only uploads, sharing permissions, OAuth scopes, push notifications and storage plans, none of which are about telemetry controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
